test_join_where_basic: test the join_where method to perform an inequality join between two DataFrames using column comparison predicates
test_join_where_self_join: test joining a DataFrame with itself using inequality predicates on time and cost columns
test_join_where_lazy_slice: test the join_where method on LazyFrames with slice operations for offset and length parameters
test_join_where_expressions: test join_where with complex expressions including arithmetic operations and type casting on predicates
test_join_where_range_constraint: test join_where with is_between predicate and verify planner uses INNER JOIN or IEJOIN based on equality constraints
